root-directory.change-description: Switch Ensemblr to the selected root and reindex/adopt from that filesystem layout after confirmation.
root-directory.continuity-note: Shared root continuity covers filesystem, git, and config only; chat/session/checkpoint continuity is not guaranteed across apps.
root-directory.preserved-body: Switching changes where Ensemblr looks for repos, workspaces, and archived contexts. Reindex/adopt is the default behavior. Migration is a separate action. Delete or cleanup is a separate destructive action.

detail.claude-executable-not-found: {{provider}} was not found in the shell-derived PATH. Ensemblr does not ship it: install {{provider}}, then retry.
detail.claude-executable-override-broken: The configured {{provider}} executable could not be run. Clear the override to fall back to the {{command}} on your PATH, or pick a runnable binary.
detail.config-missing: No declarative config file was found; built-in defaults are active.
detail.environment-cataloged: {{configured}} configured variables, {{masked}} masked secrets, and {{reserved}} reserved runtime variables are cataloged.
detail.gh-auth-cli-not-found: GitHub CLI was not found before authentication could be checked. Install gh, then retry.

detail.gh-auth-timeout: GitHub authentication check timed out for {{hostname}}.
detail.gh-cli-failed-unknown: GitHub CLI version check failed for an unknown reason.
detail.gh-cli-not-found: GitHub CLI was not found in the shell-derived PATH. Install gh, then retry.
detail.gh-cli-output-truncated: GitHub CLI version check produced too much output.
detail.gh-cli-timeout: GitHub CLI version check timed out.
detail.git-failed-unknown: Git version check failed for an unknown reason.
detail.git-not-found: Git was not found in the shell-derived PATH. Install Git, then retry.
detail.git-not-found-macos: Git was not found in the shell-derived PATH. Install Git or Xcode Command Line Tools, then retry.
detail.git-output-truncated: Git version check produced too much output.
detail.linear-not-configured: Linear OAuth is not configured. Add app.linear.clientId to the Ensemblr config to enable Linear workflows. Linear is optional for local and GitHub-only workflows.
detail.linear-not-connected: Linear is not connected. Sign in from integration settings to enable Linear workflows.
detail.linear-reconnect-required: The stored Linear token expired and cannot be refreshed. Reconnect Linear from integration settings.
detail.managed-directories-ready: Managed repos, workspaces, and archived-contexts directories are ready.
detail.pi-agent-directory-unknown-error: Unknown Pi agent directory check error.
detail.pi-agent-directory-unverified: Pi agent directory could not be verified. Fix the Pi environment path or directory permissions, then retry.
detail.pi-executable-not-found: Pi executable could not be discovered. Install Pi, select a compatible executable or wrapper, then retry.
detail.pi-executable-probe-warning: Pi executable is present at {{path}}, but version/help probing needs attention.
detail.pi-executable-ready-no-probe: Pi executable selected from {{source}}: {{path}}. No version/help probe ran.
detail.pi-executable-ready-with-probe: Pi executable selected from {{source}}: {{path}}. {{probeKind}} probe returned: {{probeDetail}}
detail.pi-models-none: Pi listed no usable models. Configure at least one provider in Pi, then retry.
detail.pi-models-unverified: Pi provider/model readiness could not be verified.
detail.pi-rpc-invalid: Pi RPC startup did not produce valid JSONL.
detail.pi-rpc-ready: Pi RPC startup produced a valid {{frameType}} frame from {{cwd}}.
detail.secret-storage-encrypted: Secrets are encrypted by the {{backend}} keyring.
detail.secret-storage-plaintext: No keyring daemon answered, so stored secrets are only obfuscated rather than encrypted. Start gnome-keyring or KWallet and restart Ensemblr.
detail.secret-storage-unavailable: No OS keyring is available, so secrets cannot be saved. Start a keyring daemon (gnome-keyring or KWallet) and retry.
detail.shell-fallback-environment: Commands launch successfully, but shell environment resolution used a fallback.
detail.shell-ready: Commands launch successfully with the shell-derived environment.
detail.shell-smoke-failed: The process launch smoke check failed.
